tickerText: [TENNIS] DC Open finals resume Monday with Jessica Pegula leading Alexandra Eala 6-4, 1-2 after rain delays, followed by Taylor Fritz vs Rafael Jodar for the men's title • [SQUASH] Asim Khan upset top seed Noor Zaman as Pakistan places two players in today's PN Fleet Club Open semi-finals in Karachi • [BADMINTON] 17-year-old Tanvi Sharma won the Taipei Open 21-16, 21-16 — the youngest champion in tournament history • [PICKLEBALL] The PPA Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open runs August 6–9 as the tour's international swing continues after the Wisconsin Challenger • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Yokohama opens August 4 at the BUNTAI without world No. 1 Wang Chuqin as Tomokazu Harimoto defends his title

newsItems.title: Asim Stuns Top Seed in Karachi
newsItems.excerpt: Pakistan's Asim Khan upset No. 1 seed Noor Zaman to reach the PN Fleet Club Open semi-finals, joining Nasir Iqbal as two home players chase the $41,000 title.

newsItems.title: Tanvi Claims Taipei Open
newsItems.excerpt: At 17, Tanvi Sharma beat Nguyen Thuy Linh 21-16, 21-16 to win her maiden BWF Super 300 title — the youngest Taipei Open champion in tournament history.

newsItems.title: PPA Asia 500 Up Next
newsItems.excerpt: The Wisconsin PPA Challenger has wrapped in Lake Hallie as the tour heads to Vietnam for the PPA Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open, August 6–9.

newsItems.title: Yokohama Draw Set
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Yokohama begins August 4 with world No. 1 Wang Chuqin absent from the draw, opening the door for defending champion Tomokazu Harimoto at home.
